data.name: Azir
data.gender_notes: Azir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'azr', meaning 'exalted' or 'mighty'. In Islamic tradition, it refers to Allah's supreme power and greatness. The name Azir carries the meaning “Mighty, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azir usually hope their child will grow to embody mighty, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Azir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mighty, Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azir total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عازر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عزر بمعنى معزز ومساعد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عازر مشتق من الجذر عزر، ويعني الشخص الذي يعزز ويساعد الآخرين. له دلالة على معنى العزة والمساعدة في اللغة العربية، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية بمعنى الشخص الذي يعين ويساند.

in_urdu.name: عازر
